transcript.text:
I don't have network/tool access in this session to fetch the live docs, so this is from prior knowledge of docs.astro.build (Astro's documentation site, sourced from `withastro/docs`) — verify against the current site.

**Documentation topics (sidebar sections):**

- **Start Here** — Getting Started, Installation, Editor Setup, Migrate to Astro, Tutorials (Build a Blog)
- **Core Concepts** — Why Astro, Astro Islands, Rendering Modes (static/SSR/on-demand)
- **Basics / Build your site** — Project Structure, Components, Pages, Layouts, Astro Template Syntax (Expressions), Styles & CSS, Markdown, Scripts & Event Handling, Routing, Endpoints, Middleware, Images, Fonts, Content Collections, Astro DB, Actions, Sessions, Server Islands, View Transitions, Prefetch, Internationalization (i18n), Data Fetching, On-demand Rendering / Adapters
- **Guides** — Deploy (Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare, GitHub Pages, etc.), Integrations, UI Frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Preact, Alpine), CMS guides, Backend services, E-commerce, Authentication, Testing, Environment Variables, Imports, Server-side rendering, Troubleshooting, Upgrade to v5/v4/v3, RSS, Sitemap, Syntax Highlighting, Fonts, Dev Toolbar
- **Reference** — Configuration Reference, Runtime/`Astro` global API, Integrations API, Adapter API, Image Service API, Dev Toolbar App API, Container API, Content Loader API, CLI Commands, Error Reference, `astro:*` module imports, Directives Reference (`client:*`, `set:html`, etc.), Template Directives, Programmatic API
- **Community / Meta** — Contribute, Roadmap, Changelog/Release notes, Themes & Integrations directory
